description_en: Modifies the column encryption algorithm configuration for a specified instance
description_zh: 修改指定实例的列加密算法配置
name: ModifyDBInstanceCLS

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable column encryption. Valid values:

`1`: Enabled

`0`: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
列加密状态。可以选择：
1（开启加密）
0（关闭加密）
parameters.name: encryption_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the customer managed key (CMK) from Key Management Service (KMS). This parameter is required when you set `EncryptionKeyMode` to `kms_key`
parameters.help_zh: 加密密钥ID，使用KMS密钥时必填
parameters.name: encryption_key

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role. For more information, see RAM role overview.
This parameter applies only when you set `EncryptionKeyMode` to `kms_key`. If you do not specify this parameter, a default internal value is used
parameters.help_zh:
角色的全局资源描述符，用来指定具体角色。详情请参见 RAM 角色概览。
说明
仅当列加密密钥模式为kms_key生效。如果不传入，使用内部默认值
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en:
The source of the encryption key for column encryption. Valid values:

`client_key`: a randomly generated key that is managed on the client.

`kms_key`: a CMK that is managed in KMS.

After you configure an instance to use a key from KMS, you cannot change the key source to `client_key`
parameters.help_zh:
列加密密钥模式。可以选择：

client_key（在客户端侧配置用户自行生成的随机密钥）
kms_key（使用阿里云KMS配置自定义密钥）

说明
一旦实例被设置成使用KMS配置密钥，将无法再使用客户端侧配置随机密钥的方式
parameters.name: encryption_key_mode

parameters.help_en:
The encryption algorithm. Valid values:

AES_128_CBC

AES_128_GCM

AES_128_CTR

AES_128_ECB

AES_256_CBC

AES_256_GCM

AES_256_CTR

AES_256_ECB

SM4_128_CBC

SM4_128_GCM

SM4_128_CTR

SM4_128_ECB
parameters.help_zh:
加密使用的算法。可以选择：

AES_128_CBC
AES_128_GCM
AES_128_CTR
AES_128_ECB
AES_256_CBC
AES_256_GCM
AES_256_CTR
AES_256_ECB
SM4_128_CBC
SM4_128_GCM
SM4_128_CTR
SM4_128_ECB
parameters.name: encryption_algorithm

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the allowlist. If you set this parameter to `true`, only columns in the allowlist are encrypted. If you set this parameter to `false`, all columns are encrypted
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用白名单模式，true表示仅白名单内的列进行加密，false表示所有列都加密
parameters.name: white_list_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to rotate the key
parameters.name: is_rotate

schema.description_en: The data returned by the request

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
